post.description: Records a beneficiary creation and answers 202 with the operation that tracks it. Admits a customer token without requiring a fresh iat: this is the one financial mutation where that is a deliberate choice rather than an omission. The Idempotency-Key header binds for at least the replay window published by GET /v1/identity. Inside that guaranteed window an equal replay returns the same operation with Idempotent-Replayed set to true. A client with an unresolved response must stop before the window ends and reconcile operation history rather than retry later. A transport-uncertain provider write leaves the operation indeterminate and is never repeated. The beneficiary becomes readable through GET /v1/beneficiaries when the operation succeeds.
